Based on previous literature on the role of the medial OFC in emotion regulation and decision-making, as well as medial OFC differences often seen in brain activation and structure between ADP and HC and the fact that ADP show impaired performance on tasks designed to tap medial OFC function, we performed region of interest (ROI) analysis using a predefined bilateral anatomical mask of the medial OFC ( http://www.fmri.wfubmc.edu/software/PickAtlas ) at the significance level of P < 0.05 FWE correcting for multiple comparisons with a cluster extend k ≥ 10.
